summary: Implemented the Databricks OAuth profile mapping. Added cosmos/profiles/databricks/oauth.py with DatabricksOauthProfileMapping (required fields host, schema, http_path, client_id, client_secret; secret fields client_id and client_secret; profile sets auth_type to oauth and both secrets as env-var references). Registered it directly after the token mapping in profile_mappings and added it to the package exports in cosmos/profiles/__init__.py and cosmos/profiles/databricks/__init__.py. Added tests/profiles/databricks/test_dbr_oauth.py covering claim checks, token-vs-OAuth selection, profile output, profile-arg overrides, and env-var outputs. Tests were not run and nothing was committed, per instructions; all verification was by reading the code against the base class.
